headline: Review and approval of the investment policy, and on-site inspections of obligated sites.
summary: The meeting will review and approve an investment policy. It will also include on-site inspections of the obligated sites.
items: Review and acceptance or approval of the investment policy
On-site inspections of the obligated sites
location: Meeting Room 1-2, City Hall, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, Connecticut
plain_text:
City of Bristol 
Storm Water Trust 
 
 
 
 
 
A meeting of the Bristol Storm Water Control Trust will be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, 
at 8:30 a.m. in Meeting Room 1-2, City Hall, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, Connecticut.  The 
meeting will continue throughout the City at the obligated sites. 
 
 
  
1. Call to Order 
2. Review and Acceptance/Approval of Investment Policy. 
3. On-site inspections of the obligated sites. 
4. Adjournment 
  
 
 
PER ORDER OF THE CHAIRMAN 
 
Raymond A. Rogozinski
